folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B297: corrected high-tier map and current use
folds.body:
The full original 206-line owner was reviewed, including HTP1–HTP54, both build orders, the three attributed dives and same-day locator refinements. Keep the chronology rather than using the first table as today's source audit. HTP31 corrects the unwired trial claim; HTP33 distinguishes calendar arithmetic from an owned-place clock; HTP34 corrects Seq7 as data-only because per-rung state/readers were missing; HTP53 then HTP54 qualify promotion time with an ordinary member lacking the acting method versus a digestion/soundness assessment earned by means. Those source distinctions do not create a universal elapsed-time gate or a new automatic promotion.

The earlier HTP25/26 blanket recall/unread descriptions are qualified by the later selected dives, without turning their windows into whole-arc reading. Lane A's approximately 4,500 words, lane B's approximately 10,000 words/40 windows and lane C's saved-owner-only comparison are different evidence. Six corrected locators and the timing-estimate warning retain exact scoped precedence. Death-line missing details mean not found in the searched evidence, not canon-wide nonexistence. The separate later chapter/blocked-source wishlist is a preserved question list, not permission to launch readers, fetch digests or fabricate missing acts as canon.

Keep the valuable mechanism distinctions: a rung is not its actual newly supported verb; owned place/terrain/produce/rights and local elapsed time need actual consumers; body age, place hazards and outside history can use different clocks; a ranked faculty/item is not the practitioner's own rank; controlled bodies, autonomous companions and ordinary party support need different control/identity/means; actual audience reaction or evidence is different from a personal acting counter. A hidden tier is not public just because a profile table exists. Registry domain and territory field retain their different meanings. Present code/source/world owners determine which seams already work, not these old ceiling snapshots.

Do not generalize a unique-item example to an entire family. A world-unique specific Gu, conserved characteristic, exact entrusted object, ordinary artifact or Memory follows its own source identity, custody and renewal rules; a unique registry does not make every Sealed Artifact or Memory a singleton. A new resource/ingredient layer does not automatically authorize lower-to-higher currency conversion. Physical conservation/aggregation can be a mechanism without a simulated hostile agent; institutional attention needs actual observers, knowledge and means. Compare the actual effect and target law, with any equalization an explicit local dial, rather than auto-converting all ranks or banning reasonable conversions.

High power may retire a former scarcity or hazard. Lower-tier services remain useful where their actual mechanism matters; they are not compulsory errands or a reason to invent matching opposition. Ingredient/feeding, upkeep and life-span changes remain source/world-specific, not global numerical taxes or proof that a larger cap always needs a new subsystem. The three-to-four-wave RI estimate and mostly-data expectation are planning judgments, not measured cost or admission law. A meaningful high-tier result must have its selected actual consumer; reuse can be narrow and does not require all HTP43–HTP52 first.

The original realm/prestige gate is retired, current [project focus](../PROJECT.md#current-focus) puts depth in book worlds/menus, and Frontier/Mistglass remain test beds. Old Frontier-home-first recommendations, B2 writer reservations, runtime-unassigned world labels, schema defaults and named module headers do not set today's queue or authorizations. Preserve all ordinary/exceptional routes as possibilities while following current lead and world owners. Current compatibility direction governs selected state changes and current-format persistence still needs proof. This pass creates no source rule, runtime implementation, source acquisition, new gate or user acceptance.
